request: Analyze GSE235174 for the paper (Regulation of whole-transcriptome sequencing expression in COPD after personalized precise exercise training: a pilot study): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: Total RNA (ribo-depleted) whole-transcriptome RNA-seq of peripheral blood leukocytes; mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA (and small-RNA library for miRNA, not deposited here)
final.inclusion: 4 male COPD patients, each sampled pre- and post-12-week personalized aerobic training (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1, TAB1); 8 libraries
final.primary_estimand: Change in mRNA expression in leukocytes of COPD patients after vs before 12 weeks of aerobic exercise training (post vs pre)
planned_contrasts: post-exercise vs pre-exercise, mRNA (S3.2.p1; paper: 86 DE-mRNAs, 47 up / 39 down)
final.paper_method: DESeq (2012) R package, two-group comparison post vs pre (pairing not stated); HTSeq counts for mRNA, Cufflinks for lncRNA, CIRI for circRNA (S2.4.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single pre/post intervention study. S2.4.p2 names DESeq (2012) with 'P-value < 0.05'; S3.2.p1 and S4.p2 add log2 FoldChange >= 1 (FIG2 caption writes > 1 and P < 0.05). Raw p, not FDR. No pairing or subject term is described for the DESeq analysis (only clinical variables use a paired t-test, S2.12.p1).

checks: DA.p1 says the data are in GEO; GSE235174 contact institute Pudong New Area Gongli Hospital = study site (S2.1.p1)
8 GSM samples = 4 patients x pre/post, peripheral blood, Homo sapiens, total RNA, matching S2.2.p1
Supplementary counts file holds mRNA, lncRNA and circRNA blocks matching S2.4.p2

ownership.reasoning: Accession, institution, design and assays all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns aPR_1..4/bPR_1..4 equal the title suffix (Expression_aPR_1). GEO treatment field: aPR = 'after 12weeks aerobic exercises', bPR = 'NC' (pre) -> time post/pre. subject is the numeric suffix; that aPR_k and bPR_k are the same patient is inferred from the naming only, not stated in GEO or the paper.

matrix.reasoning: Block 1 of GSE235174_counts_allsamples.txt.gz (gene_id_mRNA + 8 columns), split by prep_split_blocks.py: 20,028 gene symbols, 100% integers, column sums 11.5-21.3 M. S2.4.p2: 'read counts of each gene were obtained by HTSeq-count'. The FPKM file is the Cufflinks FPKM and is not used. Paper input for DESeq is these counts.

design.subject: subject
design.reasoning: Within-patient pre/post exercise contrast, 4 vs 4. Only one factor; all patients male (TAB1), so no sex split. Paper estimand is the post-vs-pre change.

candidates.reason_rejected: identical split to title-derived time; title used for formula-safe levels

covariance.reasoning: Paper's DESeq analysis is a two-group comparison with no subject term (S2.4.p2), so the paper-aligned primary run is unblocked. The design is truly repeated-measures, but the pairing key is only inferred from sample-name suffixes, so a subject-blocked DESeq2 run is added as a secondary sensitivity analysis rather than the primary route.

paper_route.reason: original DESeq package is not available in this environment; DESeq2 is its successor with the same negative-binomial counts model

method.reasoning: Counts -> negative-binomial model as in the paper; DESeq2 replaces DESeq as a declared deviation.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule (raw p < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1) applied unchanged on the DESeq2 route; BH padj < 0.05 reported as audit.

threshold.reasoning: S3.2.p1 / S4.p2: log2 FoldChange >= 1.0 and p-values < 0.05 (both directions counted).

caveats: n = 4 patients; raw-p threshold gives many false positives expected under the null
DESeq2 shrinkage/dispersion differs from DESeq (2012), so exact counts will differ
pairing in the secondary run is inferred from sample names
